Also, under exactly-lossless greedy verify a pure drafter flip cannot fork the served stream, so calling p1's fork 'S3-class drafter flip, not S1' elides the necessary near-tie target-row flip from arm-level drift.

The BI=1 comparison (22 events, 0 missing, 7.1x) carries the claim.

S1 VERDICT: HEALED — measured and discriminating, not asserted. Post-fix tree boot (FR13_TREE_BONUS_SELF=1 recorded in run_header.json and the artifact header; BI=1, FR13_BI_TREE_ATTN=1, greedy 0.0/1.0/1313, pinned prompts): 182 events / 61 full-accepts / 21 [0,2]-winner events — all 21 serve st[2] (18 discriminating vs the legacy node-8 row; the 21st is clipped, log-row-asserted only), bonus_violations=0, superset_violations=0 with true spine_path_idx=3. Same-event, same-reference healing: prompt-3's [0,2]-winner at gen_pos 12 serves 3418 == native's token; match_len vs the SAME BI=0 native reference used for the pre-fix table goes 14->31; forks 16/24/21/14 -> 16/11/25/31. Independent of committer self-logging via the served-stream fork test, byte-identical on rep2, fix verified in HEAD 4d45be27 (pushed), 7/7 tests pass on re-run. Artifact: output/fr13_s1s2s3_discriminate/s1_regate.json. Activation caveat stands: running container needs relaunch.

S2 VERDICT: REPRODUCED + CAPTURED; survives BI equalization => tree-arm verify-forward corruption, not BI noise (forced). Deterministic: byte-identical within-boot replay (tree_greedy_rep2 serves the same corrupt 369 at p0 pos 16, identical 331/182 stats) and cross-boot recurrence of the identical flip (pre-fix ev#7: 369 vs 3051, native margin 7.25, same position). fp32 logits banked on both arms (tree_greedy call6 + native_bi1_greedy call5); present vs both BI=0 and BI=1 natives (~7.1x lockstep baseline vs BI=1 over 22 events; the BI=0 multiplier rests on a 6-event baseline). TRIGGER CONTEXT RECORDED, NOT BOUND: the previous event was an acc=2 branch commit ([0,1,4], reject_parent_target) — a single replayed instance; the pre-fix association of corruption with prev_acc=2 was weak (16.9% vs 9.0%), and t06 produced 0 corrupt events in 21 pairs. 'Follows a branch commit' is a hypothesis for the conv-prior-window seam family, to be tested at the deferred state-capture re-boot. S2 is the only GROSS-margin (>1) lossless violation identified at greedy; the p1@11/p2@25/p3@31 forks are additional strict divergences classified (plausibly, not per-event-proven) as near-tie flips within the native BI/boot floor.

S3 MECHANISM: m2 REFUTED (forced): flips survive BI equalization, and the native BI1-vs-BI0 control floor (identical-rate 0.714, bundling boot+BI noise) sits far above all tree-vs-native rates (0.182-0.533). Alt-topology effect SUPPORTED (directional, not statistically forced per-event): chain closer to native than caterpillar in both references (identical-rate 0.533/0.400 vs 0.348/0.182, n=15 vs 22/23 pairs — individually non-significant; pooled per-depth flips 25/75 vs 64/110 corroborate). The supported effect therefore lives on the verify side — 9-row vs 5-row tree verify forward + branch-commit state advance (conv prior-window gather ~:797-818, GDN h0 handoff on branch winners, drafter-layer slot reuse) — fix direction described only; decisive A/B = caterpillar with forced-spine commits vs chain. Residual after alt removal -> m3 and/or arm-level forward drift (unbound); chain gen_pos-1 full-depth flips on prompts 1/2/3 predate any alt or commit and bound a non-m1/non-m3 arm-level drift share.
